major_issues.issue: 解读稿在'Q3 及其六、总体结论'部分引入 Ajikumar 2010 的 '1 g/L 级紫杉二烯' 以及'相比之下 E. coli 已 1 g/L 级'等具体数值，原文并未提供该定量比较
major_issues.source_locator: 解读稿'六、总体结论'末段与'八、Q3'对照句：'与已发表的 E. coli 中 1 g/L 级紫杉二烯（Ajikumar et al., 2010 [7]）相比'，原文 §3.1、Discussion 仅说'[7] 提升约 15,000 倍'与'T2 相对可行'，无 1 g/L 直接定量

verified_claims.claim: E. coli T2 摇瓶紫杉二烯产量 11.3 ± 0.5 mg/L (13.2 mg/gDCW)、T4 5.0 ± 0.7 mg/L (5.9 mg/gDCW)
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'The titers of taxadiene produced by mutants T2 and T4 at the shaking flask level were 11.3 ± 0.5 mg/L (13.2 mg/gDCW) and 5.0 ± 0.7 mg/L (5.9 mg/gDCW; Figure 2B), respectively.'

verified_claims.claim: GB127 紫杉二烯产量 61.9 ± 6.3 μg/L
verified_claims.evidence: 原文 abstract：'we could detect 61.9 ± 6.3 μg/L taxadiene in the engineered strain GB127'；§3.4：'a maximum concentration of 61.9 ± 6.3 μg/L (Figure 4B and 4C).'
原文：'This result was reproduced in five parallel experiments, indicating that taxadiene could be constantly overexpressed in this strain.'

verified_claims.claim: 启动子强度由 GB93 (gpdA) 4.5×10³ 到 GB94 (alcA) 3.4×10⁷，跨度 >7,000 倍；排序 alcA > agdA > trpC > glaA > oliC > gpdA
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'the strength of the promoters ranged from 4.5 × 10³ (GB93) to 3.4 × 10⁷ (GB94), with a span of more than 7,000 times, in the order of alcA > agdA > trpC > glaA > oliC > gpdA (Figure 3B).'

verified_claims.claim: MEP 途径工程使 E. coli 紫杉二烯提高约 15,000 倍（引用 [7] Ajikumar 2010）
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'the production of taxadiene was increased approximately 15,000-fold [7].'

verified_claims.claim: A. alternata TPF6 转录组测序检测到 10,612 个预测基因；hmg1 转录水平偏低，erg10/13/12/8/mvd1/idi 充足
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'10612 predicted genes were detected… the transcript levels of erg10, erg13, erg12, erg8, mvd1, and idi… were satisfactory… the transcription level of hmg1 was relatively low.'

verified_claims.claim: GB123 (alcAp-TS)、GB125 (trpCp-Idi + alcAp-TS)、GB127 (trpCp-Idi + oliCp-tHMG1 + alcAp-TS) 三菌为递进构建
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'The mutants GB123 (harboring the ts gene), GB125 (harboring the ts gene plus the idi gene), and GB127 (harboring the ts gene plus the idi and thmg1 genes; Table 1, Figure 4A) were constructed.'
